facts.business: Super Iron Foundry Limited manufactures iron castings with 72,000 MT annual capacity, serving 30+ countries across 7 core product areas including municipal and railway castings, with overseas operations in UAE and Saudi Arabia.
key_risks: Volatility in prices of key raw materials (pig iron, scrap) linked to domestic and international metal/commodity prices
Significant management judgement in determination of net realisable value of inventories
Allocation of production overheads to work-in-progress and finished goods based on normal capacity
